name: Methyl glucose dioleate
description: Methyl glucose dioleate (CAS 82933-91-3 ) is a sugar-derived ester produced from methyl glucoside and oleic acid. It functions as an emulsifier, moisturizing agent, and lubricant across personal care and industrial applications. It bridges the performance gap between synthetic emulsifiers and naturally derived alternatives. This chemical offers formulators a mild, skin-compatible option with multifunctional utility for diverse product lines. In personal care formulations, it stabilizes oil-in-water emulsions in creams, lotions, and conditioners. It simultaneously contributes to skin-feel and moisture retention for high-end cosmetic applications. Cleansing products benefit from its ability to solubilize oils without stripping the skin. This is particularly useful in facial cleansers and micellar systems targeting sensitive skin types and delicate areas. In metalworking and industrial lubricant formulations, it functions as a bio-based lubricating additive. It improves surface slip and reduces friction in cutting fluids and other heavy-duty industrial processes. Home care and cleaning product manufacturers incorporate it into concentrated surfactant blends. It is ideal where emulsification of oily soils is required alongside mildness to various substrates and surfaces. Methyl glucose dioleate is typically supplied as a liquid or semi-solid paste, depending on temperature and grade. Personal care grades are available to meet cosmetic-quality specifications for global distribution. Technical grades serve industrial lubricant and cleaning applications with high efficiency.
